messages.content: Give me the price of a Tesla model S in India.

function.name: get_exchange_rate
function.description: Retrieve the current exchange rate between two currencies. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
Tesla has not officially launched the Model S (or any other Model) in India yet, so there is no published Indian price.  
When it does launch, the price will likely be set in U.S. dollars and then converted to Indian rupees using the prevailing exchange rate, plus import duties and taxes that apply to electric vehicles in India. Until an official announcement is made, you’ll only see estimates based on the U.S. MSRP and current currency rates.
